data.name: Sahbaj
data.gender_notes: Sahbaj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sahbaj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sah-bhaaj', which means 'lion's share'. It is a name that conveys strength, courage, and wisdom. Sahbaj is a name for a child who is destined to be a fearless leader, one who takes on challenges with bravery and determination. The name Sahbaj carries the meaning “Brave, Fearless, Lion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sahbaj usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, fearless, lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sahbaj is a name that resonates with the divine energy of the lion, a symbol of power and courage in Hindu mythology. It is believed that a child named Sahbaj will embody the fearless spirit of the lion, and will be blessed with the strength and courage to overcome any obstacle in life.
data.etymology: Sahbaj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, Fearless, Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sahbaj total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

By being given the name Sahbaj, a child is blessed with the characteristics of a fearless leader. Moreover, as per Hindu beliefs, a lion's roar is believed to dispel fear and negativity, making Sahbaj an inspiring and empowering name for a child.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the lion is an embodiment of Shiva, one of the major deities, representing strength, transformation, and salvation. Naming a child Sahbaj signifies receiving the blessings of Lord Shiva, who is both feared for his fierceness and revered as the ultimate savior. This spiritual significance imparts a deep sense of purpose and protection to a child, instilling both courage and humility within them as they grow. Additionally, the name Sahbaj also resonates with the wisdom and power of the lion as per the Hindu tradition, which is a reminder of the potential and responsibility that comes with every name. Ultimately, Sahbaj serves as an inspiration for personal growth, encouraging a child to embody the fearlessness, power, and wisdom of the revered lion in their own life.
